file: # Target labels: four 32x16 sprites, each with an icon in columns 0-11.
# screen order is One, Self, Many, All; the tengeki copies are byte-identical.
# Many occupies all 20 columns, so its shadow is omitted in both copies.
# Waiting banner: three 32x32 tiles read 待 / 機 / 中. All nonzero indices are lettering.
# Each 32x16 sprite has only 20 columns beside its icon. Minimum accepted labels with font s,
# without shadow: Attack 26px, Restore 31px, Weaken 30px, Boost 22px.
# Need a wider runtime sprite/layout (and corresponding generator support), or an approved
# narrower lettering option. Preserve the icons and original text pending that work.
# Glossary Star is 17px wide with font s, without shadow; font 8 is 20px.
